## Network and public specification

Exact network / chain:
Source spec URL and version:
Native, issued, mint, denom, contract or UTXO identity semantics:

## One reproducible behavior

Describe **one** native chain behavior. Do not claim existing implementation merely because a chain appears on the roadmap.

## Public-only synthetic fixture

Describe a fabricated positive case with expected field and event semantics, and provide a public reference for the behavior.

## Falsifier and negative controls

- Wrong network or conflicting source
- Missing transaction, page, log, receipt or finality proof
- Ambiguous asset identity or unqualified cross-chain equivalence
- Ordinary/benign counterexample to any suspicious pattern

## Read-only and resource budget

State the proposed bounded input, source method, completeness checks, time/byte budgets and failure/abstention behavior. No live polling is required for an initial PR.

## Publication check

- [ ] All content is original, synthetic or independently licensed public protocol material.
- [ ] No private implementation, protected invention, account owner dossiers, credentials or secrets.
- [ ] No signer, trade submission, financial execution, unauthorized monitoring or public allegation.
- [ ] Claims, unknowns and technical hypotheses are labeled separately.

See [chain adapter guide](https://github.com/Footloose9/hyperfabric-evolution/blob/main/docs/CHAIN_ADAPTER_GUIDE.md) and [publication policy](https://github.com/Footloose9/hyperfabric-evolution/blob/main/PUBLICATION_POLICY.md).
